Subject: Switch 9/28 intro demo into a scoped technical playbook (prework + split sessions)

Hi Mike / Sofia —

Quick follow-up on the 9/28 slot we have on calendar: after syncing with our SEs and product team, we think this would be higher value as a scoped technical playbook / deep-dive rather than a high-level intro. The playbook format focuses on 3 outcomes:

- Validate a 1–2 core integration pattern for your ingestions pipeline
- Run a short performance baseline with a sample dataset
- Produce a short-run playbook and next-step checklist for POC scope

Proposed changes:
1) Convert the 9/28 2-hour intro into two focused 90-min sessions (split over two days) so Eng + Security can be present for the technical parts.
2) Share a short prework packet (attached) to reduce synchronous time — prework is ~30 minutes.
3) Marissa would lead the lab run and Vivek will cover commercial / rollout questions.

Attachment: redwood_playbook_prework.pdf (slides + short checklist)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cPlaybookPrework

Can you confirm whether the execs who planned to attend will be available for two shorter blocks? If not, we can compress to one longer technical session but it will mean skipping the live ingestion baseline.

Next step: if you confirm availability, I’ll publish two proposed time slots and update the mutual action plan in HubSpot.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

- Split format: Oct 4 (90 mins) focused on architecture & ingestion pattern + pre-recorded walkthrough of the platform UI (we'll surface logs/observability).
- Oct 6 (90 mins) focused on live baseline & playbook creation with your engs (we'll run a short token-latency baseline).

Time candidates (PST / converted in the calendar stub):
- Oct 4: 10:00–11:30 PT / 13:00–14:30 ET
- Oct 6: 09:00–10:30 PT / 12:00–13:30 ET

I attached an .ics with proposed slots (proposed_time_slots.ics) — please pick the pair that matches your team. If these windows conflict with the execs at the last minute, we can instead run one consolidated 3-hour technical run and follow up with a short recorded playbook deliverable.

Action items:

- Sofia: if you want our security engineer on the call, we can include a short 20-minute section on data handling and key management.
- Vivek: I’ve asked you to prepare a 5-slide commercial outline for procurement (costing + rollout phases).
